audited_plan.custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the dental structure. AI often struggles with individual teeth, making them look like a continuous white ridge or fusing them with the jaw. Also, scrutinize the eye; real crocodiles have very specific, sharp eyelid geometries and vertical pupils which are often rendered as generic 'reptile eyes' by models. Compare the snout taper strictly against Nile Crocodile references.
